title: Chris Kelly's band and its clarinetists
summary: Vincent says he played with Chris Kelly long before Mexico and recalls Kelly working him hard; he and Allen try to recall who played clarinet for Kelly.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Chris Kelly, the blues trumpeter and his band

blocks.x: Let's see. Ask him did he play with Chris Kelly before he went to Mexico or after? He said did you play with Chris Kelly before you went to Mexico or after? Oh, long before I went to Mexico. He was a good musician too. He was a good musician too. I asked Chris Kelly to tie you out before he took you in his band.

He worked me out. He killed me from D to D to D. I didn't make a mistake. He told me to say why he got it. Ask him what tune that was. He said what tune was that? It was some wall. I can't think of it.
How much power to build this bamboo
There was some wars. I can't think of it. There was some wars he had.
Well I asked him did he play with Chris before he played with Jack Carey?

He said did you play with Chris before you played with Jack Carey? Oh yeah, Jack. And I didn't forget who Chris had. Been so long. I know a long time ago before I left he used to have Faso. Yeah, no Faso is dumb or whatever.
Harrison? Harrison you think? Yeah, I think it was Harrison. I'm trying to think of the guy that used to be with him.
He had pills and he had George Lewis and he had Mealy Barnes. Ask him was it pills or Mealy Barnes or George Lewis or who?

He said was it pills or Mealy Barnes or George Lewis on clarinet? Who? No, I didn't know George. He wasn't there until George Lewis. I knew George Lewis from over in Madisonville. He wasn't there in the city. He was there in the city. Peel? I said... I think Zed. Zed. Zed, yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. Zed was there. Yeah. More refreshing memories.
Did he want some? Ask him if he wants some. You want some? Yeah, I'll make water. I'll get that.
